name: AWS Master Vault
source: User-provided 'Every AWS Service You’ll EVER Need' learning plan, organized into seven buckets and expanded with linked AWS documentation.

categories.title: Foundation & Security
categories.purpose: Establish a safe AWS account baseline, identity controls, secrets handling and account-level guardrails.

components.name: AWS account and root MFA
components.purpose: Secure the account root user; enable MFA and avoid root access keys.

components.name: AWS IAM roles and policies
components.purpose: Grant least-privilege access using roles, trust policies and permissions policies.

components.name: IAM service roles: EC2 to S3
components.purpose: Let an EC2 workload access S3 using an instance profile instead of embedded credentials.

components.name: AWS Secrets Manager
components.purpose: Store, retrieve and rotate supported application secrets.

components.name: Systems Manager Parameter Store
components.purpose: Store application configuration and supported parameter types.

components.name: AWS Organizations and SCPs
components.purpose: Organize accounts and set permission guardrails across an organization.

components.name: AWS Control Tower
components.purpose: Establish and govern a multi-account landing zone.

components.name: AWS Budgets and billing alarms
components.purpose: Create cost thresholds and notifications; alerts do not automatically stop spend.

components.name: AWS KMS
components.purpose: Manage encryption keys and supported cryptographic operations.

components.name: AWS IAM Identity Center
components.purpose: Provide centralized workforce access to accounts and supported applications.

categories.title: Compute & Containers
categories.purpose: Choose and operate virtual machines, functions and containers according to workload control, scaling and operational effort.

components.name: Amazon EC2
components.purpose: Run virtual machines with selected instance types, storage and network controls.

components.name: EC2 Auto Scaling
components.purpose: Maintain desired capacity and scale eligible EC2 fleets.

components.name: AWS Lambda
components.purpose: Run event-driven code without managing the server fleet.

components.name: Amazon ECS
components.purpose: Orchestrate containers using AWS-native tasks and services.

components.name: AWS Fargate
components.purpose: Run eligible containers without managing EC2 worker hosts.

components.name: Amazon ECR
components.purpose: Store and distribute container images.

components.name: Amazon EKS
components.purpose: Run Kubernetes workloads on AWS; understand its additional operational complexity.

components.name: Amazon EC2 GPU instances
components.purpose: Evaluate accelerated compute for ML, graphics and parallel workloads.

components.name: AWS Batch
components.purpose: Schedule and execute batch computing jobs.

components.name: AWS App Runner
components.purpose: Deploy supported web applications and APIs with managed operations.

categories.title: Storage & Databases
categories.purpose: Choose object, block, file, relational, key-value and caching services based on data access patterns, durability, consistency and recovery.

components.name: Amazon S3
components.purpose: Store objects with bucket policies, encryption, lifecycle and versioning controls.

components.name: Amazon EBS
components.purpose: Provide block storage for EC2 and supported workloads.

components.name: Amazon EFS
components.purpose: Provide elastic shared file storage for supported Linux workloads.

components.name: Amazon RDS
components.purpose: Run managed relational databases.

components.name: Amazon Aurora
components.purpose: Run supported cloud-optimized relational workloads.

components.name: Amazon DynamoDB
components.purpose: Use a managed key-value and document database with access-pattern-driven design.

components.name: Amazon ElastiCache
components.purpose: Cache eligible application data to reduce latency and backend load.

components.name: AWS Backup
components.purpose: Centrally manage supported backup plans and recovery points.

components.name: S3 events and Lambda
components.purpose: Trigger processing from supported S3 object events.

components.name: AWS Database Migration Service
components.purpose: Migrate and replicate supported databases.

categories.title: Networking & Content Delivery
categories.purpose: Design VPC segmentation, routing, secure ingress, DNS, hybrid connectivity and content delivery.

components.name: Amazon VPC
components.purpose: Create isolated networks with address ranges, subnets, routes and gateways.

components.name: Security Groups vs Network ACLs
components.purpose: Distinguish stateful interface controls from stateless subnet-level rules.

components.name: Application Load Balancer
components.purpose: Route HTTP/HTTPS requests at Layer 7.

components.name: Network Load Balancer
components.purpose: Load-balance supported Layer 4 traffic.

components.name: Amazon Route 53
components.purpose: Host DNS zones and route queries using supported routing policies.

components.name: Amazon CloudFront
components.purpose: Cache and deliver content and supported application traffic at edge locations.

components.name: Amazon API Gateway
components.purpose: Publish and govern APIs, often integrated with Lambda.

components.name: AWS NAT Gateway
components.purpose: Provide outbound IPv4 connectivity from eligible private subnets.

components.name: AWS Transit Gateway
components.purpose: Connect multiple VPCs and supported hybrid networks.

components.name: AWS PrivateLink and VPC endpoints
components.purpose: Access supported services privately and reduce reliance on public paths.

categories.title: DevOps & Automation
categories.purpose: Make infrastructure repeatable, deployments controlled, access auditable and operational tasks automated.

components.name: AWS CloudFormation
components.purpose: Provision and manage AWS infrastructure declaratively.

components.name: AWS CDK with Python
components.purpose: Define supported infrastructure using Python constructs.

components.name: AWS CDK with TypeScript
components.purpose: Define supported infrastructure using TypeScript constructs.

components.name: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager
components.purpose: Access supported instances without exposing SSH/RDP ports or managing bastion hosts.

components.name: AWS CodePipeline
components.purpose: Orchestrate supported continuous delivery workflows.

components.name: AWS CodeBuild
components.purpose: Build and test application artifacts.

components.name: AWS CodeDeploy
components.purpose: Deploy supported application revisions to eligible targets.

components.name: Amazon EventBridge
components.purpose: Route events and trigger automation.

components.name: Terraform on AWS
components.purpose: Manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform configuration and state.

components.name: GitHub Actions with AWS OIDC
components.purpose: Use short-lived federated credentials for CI/CD rather than long-lived keys.

components.name: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

components.name: AI document-processing workflow

components.name: Amazon CloudWatch metrics, logs and alarms
components.purpose: Collect telemetry, query logs and alert on supported conditions.

components.name: CloudWatch dashboards
components.purpose: Visualize operational signals.

components.name: AWS Cost Explorer
components.purpose: Analyze historical cost and usage.

components.name: AWS Budgets
components.purpose: Set budget thresholds and notifications.

components.name: AWS CloudTrail
components.purpose: Record supported AWS API activity for audit and investigation.

components.name: AWS Config
components.purpose: Record configuration changes and evaluate supported rules.

components.name: AWS Trusted Advisor
components.purpose: Review eligible best-practice checks.

components.name: AWS Compute Optimizer
components.purpose: Review supported rightsizing recommendations.

components.name: AWS Service Quotas
components.purpose: Review service quotas and request supported increases.

components.name: AWS Free Tier and free offers
components.purpose: Check current account eligibility, offer terms and usage limits before labs.
